result_text:
The purchase orders per sales rep report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so the example in the task gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

- **Fix:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`. The subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same predicate the quarter and weekday purchase-order reports use. I also updated its Javadoc to say cancelled orders are not counted.
- **Test:** `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`. Added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`, which reproduces the example. I also gave the test's `purchaseOrder` helper a status-taking overload.
- **Result:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests, 0 errors). I did not run the new test against the unfixed code to watch it fail first.

Nothing is committed. I did not touch `findPurchaseOrdersByCountry`, which also reads purchase orders by region and does not filter cancelled ones. It is outside this report, so say if you want it changed too.
